summary: Plot supplied energy samples against one declared coordinate without turning interpolation or a sampled peak into a mechanism.
objective: Build a reaction-coordinate energy inspector where every point retains coordinate definition, energy kind, units and provenance, and transition-state labels require explicit source annotation.
intent_signals: inspect declared energy along reaction coordinate
energy profile maximum is not automatically transition state
example_prompts: Plot a supplied bond-distance coordinate against relative electronic energy and compare its sampled maximum with a separately annotated transition state.
negative_signals: Not an IRC, NEB, geometry optimization, transition-state search, free-energy calculation, kinetics model or mechanism proof.
not_for: No inferred saddle point, rate constant, elementary-step claim, mixed energy kinds/units or interpolated values presented as calculations.

entities.name: Molecular snapshots
entities.guidance: Blender supplies a stable molecular stage and optional source snapshots keyed to sample IDs. Three.js moves only to supplied coordinates and never deforms one sample into a computed intermediate.

entities.name: Profile and provenance rail
entities.guidance: Three.js owns ordered q/E samples, units, baseline and annotations. Selecting a curve segment reveals its bracketing source samples and labels interpolation as display-only.

state_contract.model: A finite ordered table of sample_id, scalar q, relative energy E, coordinate definition/unit, energy kind/unit, method/source and optional source-authored stationary-point annotation. q values must be finite and strictly increasing; all samples share one coordinate definition, energy kind, unit and provenance regime. Choose and display an explicit reference E_ref and plot ΔE=E-E_ref. A polyline or named display interpolant may guide the eye but creates no scientific samples or extrema. A local maximum among samples is labeled sampled maximum only; transition state/saddle/minimum labels require compatible source annotations, not screen shape.
state_contract.authority: Three.js owns validated samples, conversions, selection and provenance. Blender owns illustrative snapshot meshes; neither layer calculates energies or reaction paths.
actions: Load a homogeneous sample table and choose its declared relative-energy reference.
Scrub only among source samples; optionally display interpolation with a persistent non-computed label.
Compare a sampled maximum with an explicitly sourced stationary-point annotation.
Reject duplicate/nonfinite q, incompatible units/energy kinds, missing coordinate definition or unsupported annotations; reset restores the initial sample.

invariants: Each plotted marker corresponds one-to-one with a supplied sample ID and retains its original q, E and provenance.
Energy subtraction and any unit conversion are explicit and applied consistently; potential, electronic, enthalpy and Gibbs-energy profiles are not silently mixed.
A sampled or interpolated maximum is not sufficient to establish a saddle point or transition state.
Geometry tweening, curve smoothness and barrier height from sparse samples do not establish a mechanism or rate.
motion_guidance: Step commits one source frame or declared transformation; pause preserves committed state and reset restores data, view, selections and errors.
Offer a static frame/table alternative. Tweened atom, curve or surface motion explains correspondence only and never creates scientific samples.
creative_affordances: Blender may establish a distinctive molecular stage, lattice frame and stable atom/orbital glyph families; Three.js binds them to scientific IDs and data.
Materials, camera and composition remain flexible when units, provenance, sign, identity and uncertainty stay legible without color alone.
known_limits: One supplied 1D coordinate and homogeneous energy table only; no multidimensional surface, vibrational correction, uncertainty inference, kinetics or mechanism certification.
Authored, source-reviewed guidance only; no chemistry calculation, trajectory conversion, Blender export, browser, renderer or interactive artifact was run.

physical_contract.scope: Scientific coordinates and annotations drive display; mesh contact and animation do not compute chemistry.

object_craft.structure: Use a precise q/E rail with detachable sample pedestals and a linked molecular stage; keep source points physically distinct from the thin display interpolant.
object_craft.material: Source samples use solid markers with IDs; interpolation is translucent/dashed, and stationary annotations use text plus shape.

claims.statement: IUPAC defines a reaction coordinate as a geometric parameter, or sometimes an approximating non-geometric parameter, that measures progress of an elementary reaction; examples include bond lengths, bond angles or combinations.
claims.scope: Terminology for a declared coordinate; not evidence that an arbitrary chosen coordinate is a minimum-energy path.

source_refs.locator: Gold Book entry R05168, definition and notes linking reaction coordinate to potential-energy profiles and paths
